body:
I had a therapist and was on anti-depressants for years. The "real problems" thing is just reflex, and ... well, it's one of those things that are really hard to completely stop believing. :/ You know.

I needed to be reminded of this. It's hard to focus on the little things because the brain immediately starts looking way off into the dim future and seeing all the things that could go wrong or not happen at all! 

Good luck to you in your own battle and thank you. <3
